purpose: One accessible glass flyout inside LuHm MCP Apps, backed by modular chat intent cards and supervised execution gates.

kiosk.iosPreferredTest: Chrome Stable or Beta, not Canary

modules.label: Music deck
modules.description: jQuery music player, YouTube and Spotify planning; playback requires licensed provider and user interaction.
modules.chatIntent: Lum, open the LuHm music-deck planning workflow in this ChatGPT conversation. Check whether the existing jQuery media player and supported YouTube/Spotify integrations are actually available; propose the next bounded action. Do not claim playback, connect a music account or open an unauthorized stream.

modules.label: Avatar lab
modules.description: GoDaddy-labeled avatar/Python modular tools; exact capability and provider identity require verification.
modules.chatIntent: Skuld, inspect the LuHm GoDaddy avatar and Python plugin module against current Canon. Determine the exact provider/tool identity, present available avatar actions and source gaps, and request approval before executing code or opening network access.

modules.label: Yume art studio
modules.description: Art direction, image production, CSS, design assets and video/storyboard handoffs.
modules.chatIntent: Yume, open an in-chat LuHm art-studio workflow for brand, CSS, images or video. Choose a specific task from the current conversation and outline the approved asset pipeline with provenance and rights checks. Do not publish or invent a completed render.

modules.label: Publishing desk
modules.description: Social, YouTube and art post drafting with review, permissions and publishing approval.
modules.chatIntent: Belldandy and Yume, open the LuHm social publishing desk inside this chat. Prepare a reviewed draft for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or a related art post from material I explicitly provide; separate draft approval from posting. Do not access private accounts or publish without a specific authorized action.

modules.label: Admin and Canon
modules.description: Audit agent runtime, doctrine drift, releases, permissions and kiosk deployment.
modules.chatIntent: Lum, Urd and Skuld, inspect LuHm's active system state, GitHub Canon, mobile ChatGPT plugin host, release channels, worker quarantine and kiosk capability evidence. Fix bounded source defects when authorized; do not bypass Crown, signing, rights or independent runtime proof.
